images.prompt: highly detailed retro 16-bit pixel art landscape, sharp crisp pixels, intricate texture on the grass and dirt ground, vivid saturated colors, professional video game background art, sunny sky, clouds, bushes, signpost

approaches: high-detail / low-noise refinement of source bitmap

findings: Text-to-image at 1024x1024 with euler/beta, cfg 1.0, 20-32 steps gives the crispest clean pixel-art output (flux_01, flux_06) - recommended Flux baseline.
Widescreen 1344x768 t2i (flux_03) works well for side-scroller compositions.
Higher CFG (2.0) with dpmpp_2m/karras (flux_02) came out slightly soft/blurry; keep CFG 1.0-1.5 for crisp pixels.
img2img at denoise 0.55-0.7 (flux_04, flux_05) preserves the source scene layout while enhancing detail; the low-noise 0.25 refinement (flux_06) is most faithful to the source structure.
Flux Dev is guidance-distilled: empty negative prompt + cfg ~1.0 is the standard; pushing cfg higher degrades quality rather than adding prompt adherence.
